name: run-abroad
tagline: Fill in 10 fields to filter 71 visa and immigration routes
description: run-abroad is a static, zero-dependency web utility that filters 71 visa and immigration pathways based on ten personal fields. No backend, no account, no data leaves the browser — you answer a short form and get the routes that actually fit your profile. A genuinely practical everyday tool that reached 278 stars in a single day.
highlights: Filters 71 visa and immigration routes from 10 personal fields
Static and zero-dependency — no backend, no account
Your data never leaves the browser
curatorNote: Immigration research is a maze of eligibility rules scattered across official pages. A static filter that collapses 71 routes into a 10-field form is exactly the kind of practical utility the web is supposed to have.
